subject: AtlasCare SOC2 + infra deep-dive: scheduling, pre-reads, and evidence checklist
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@atlascare.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 architecture review — scheduling and prep

Hi Monica / Neha,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Our security team would like to schedule a technical deep-dive focused on SOC 2 evidence mapping: SSO, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, audit logging, and key management. We want to come away with a clear list of evidence artifacts and an architecture walkthrough so our auditors can understand the runtime controls.

Suggested windows (PST):
- Thu Feb 12, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Fri Feb 13, 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00

Attendees from our side initially:
- Tom Reynolds (Security lead)
- Priya Sood (Infra)
- plus one or two auditors (TBD)

Attached: prelim list of questions we want to cover (atlascare_prelim_qs.pdf). Can you confirm who from Redwood would attend and share any pre-reads?

Appreciate it,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Security, AtlasCare
T: +1-415-555-0234

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@atlascare.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 architecture review — scheduling and prep

Tom — thanks for the note and the questions. We're happy to run a focused session. Proposed Redwood attendees:
- Monica Patel — Account Executive (owner)
- Neha Kapoor — Solutions Engineer (run architecture & evidence mapping)
- David Kim — Infra Architect (encryption/ops + audit logs)

We can do either Thu Feb 12 14:00–15:00 PST or Fri Feb 13 15:00–16:00 PST. The latter works best for David (he's OOO in the morning on the 13th).

I've uploaded a short agenda / pre-read (redwood_soc2_meeting_agenda_v1.pdf) that pulls together the artifacts we typically share and a suggested flow: 1) architecture walkthrough, 2) evidence mapping to trust services criteria, 3) follow-up artifact delivery plan.

If Feb 13 15:00–16:00 PST works for you, we'll send a calendar invite and attach an evidence checklist. Otherwise, confirm the 12th slot and we'll adjust.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (628) 555-0199
--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@atlascare.io>

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 architecture review — scheduling and prep

Monica — appreciate the clarity. Apologies — conflict came up for the 12th. Can we move to Fri Feb 13, 15:00–16:00 PST (that should also buy us time to gather the auditor list)?

Also: can you share a SOC 2 evidence checklist or a mapping template we can use ahead of the call? That will help us identify ownership for any artifacts.

Cc'ing Priya who will be joining from infra.

Thanks,
Tom

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@atlascare.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sood <priya.sood@atlascare.io>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 architecture review — scheduling and prep

Tom / Monica / Priya — moving to confirm Fri Feb 13, 15:00–16:00 PST (that's 18:00–19:00 EST). I'm sending a calendar invitation now ("AtlasCare — SOC2 architecture deep-dive").

Quick pre-read and artifacts we'll reference during the call (attached):
- soc2_evidence_checklist.xlsx — mapping template (evidence, owner, location, retention)
- redwood_encryption_brief.pdf — short note on keys, KMS, and envelope encryption
- redwood_preread_arch_diagram.png — high-level runtime diagram

On the call we'll walk the live architecture diagram, then run through the checklist to mark items you already have vs. items we will deliver post-call. Expected outputs: a dated artifact list and an owners table.

Action items for AtlasCare before the call:
- Confirm auditor attendees (if they're joining)
- Share any specific evidence formats your auditor requires (e.g., log retention exports, KMS key policy snapshots)
- If you need IP allowlisting for access to any demo systems, send the public IPs and CIDR ranges to infra@redwood.ai (David is on cc).

Attachments: soc2_evidence_checklist.xlsx, redwood_encryption_brief.pdf, redwood_preread_arch_diagram.png

Thanks — see you Friday.

--
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@atlascare.io>, Priya Sood <priya.sood@atlascare.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 architecture review — scheduling and prep

Tom / Priya — confirmed for Fri Feb 13, 15:00–16:00 PST. Calendar invite sent (please accept).

David will own the runtime diagram walkthrough and the audit-logs section; Neha will drive the evidence checklist. We'll capture any redlines and follow up with dated artifact delivery (SLA: initial artifact bundle within 5 business days after the call).

A few operational notes ahead of the session:
- If your auditors need temporary access to a demo environment, please list the IP ranges for whitelisting to infra@redwood.ai.
- For SSO/SAML screenshots, if you can share examples of your IdP metadata or a test account, that speeds up verification.
- We'll provide signed hash digests for sample logs where auditors request tamper evidence — we'll talk through options on the call.

Attached is a short pre-read (redwood_preread_arch_diagram.png) and the agenda. If anything changes on your side, let us know and we can pivot.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (628) 555-0199
